standing: actual Claude coauthor probe; design/reference evidence only, no product qualification and no runtime security claim
reviewerFinding: post-reset-review.v9 v9-S1; construction follows the reviewer probes probes/p03_residue_enforcement.py and probes/p04_third_limb.py, which are theirs

annotations.codec: SHA-256 over the fully framed domain-separated preimage: u8 len||domainTag, u8 len||levelId, u8 len||levelVersion (RAW 32 bytes, not hexadecimal display text), u8 len||languageId, u8 len||languageVersion, u32be len||payload. Unframed concatenation is FORBIDDEN.

payloadEncoding.L0-verbatim: u32be raw_byte_len || exact snapshot body-span bytes; tokenisation forbidden

annotations.join: the frame is retained under the 64-hex suffix, so SHA-256(retained frame) equals it; the closure parses the frame and requires domainTag, levelId == normalisationLevel, levelVersion == the RAW 32 digest bytes of normalisationVersion, languageId from the fact sourceUniverse domain row, languageVersion == the RAW 32 digest bytes of the recomputed body-language-version projection, and at L0-verbatim the payload equals the enclosing fact anchor span bytes
annotations.neverEquals: FACT-ID-V1. The fact identity wraps the complete clone fact and can never equal or substitute for bodyIdentity, by type or by domain (docs/coop/artifacts/fact-identity-policy.v2.json#/factRecordIdentityBoundaryV1/clonePayloadJoin).

annotations.artifact: the exact retained canonical LEVEL SPECIFICATION bytes for this normalisation level: per-language lexical boundary rules, canonical token-kind registry, directive classification, transform order and replacement byte rules
annotations.note: A human semantic-version label alone is insufficient, and this is never an opaque caller hash.

annotations.join: must be a path in the enclosing fact snapshot source inventory

annotations.artifact: the exact retained source bytes of that inventoried path
annotations.join: must equal the inventory row sha256 for path, and the retained blob must exist

annotations.artifact: the exact byte length of those retained bytes
annotations.join: must equal the inventory row bytes and the retained blob length
must be a path in the enclosing fact snapshot source inventory
must be a path in the enclosing fact snapshot source inventory UNLESS changeKind is deleted, in which case the path is by definition absent from the analysed snapshot
the pre-rename path names a state BEFORE the analysed snapshot and is deliberately not joined to it; it is provenance, and claiming otherwise would refuse every honest rename
